brief: Holds music as data: a flat list of timed notes, rests and drum strokes, measured in beats rather than seconds.
detail: Everything from one note to a whole piece is the same type, so Then, Together, Repeat, On and Transpose work on all of it. An event is [ startBeat, beats, hz, instrument, velocity, stroke, glideEndHz ]. The performance settings Tempo, Quantize and Swing turn beats into frames only when a sound is made, in FrameOf, so one score can be rendered at two speeds or swung and straight without being rewritten. A refused call leaves the score unchanged, counts in Refusals and explains itself in LastError. ToSound renders to memory with no audio device; Play goes live through the scheduler. The result has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED): it is checked by frame count, sample rate and peak level.
